comment: The release's table of OpenAbstractions component ids (A-SEC6, architect rulings 2026-11-22 (1) and the declarer amendment). components: each provider program, the provider names it ships, and per name the components that may declare it (declarers). instance_names are prefixes Setup completes with -<lowercase hex>. declarer_programs: OA's other programs, resolved to a component id when they declare. original_name is the signed version resource's OriginalFilename, required for a program outside the per-machine install folder; a program without one resolves only from that folder. oa:cli and oa:mcp are never declarers. Setup, inside the Panel, declares the model host's modelhost and pytorch through the Panel's registry client.
